name: אַבְרָהָם
summary: Abraham is the patriarch whose name is used in Psalm 47.10 for the covenant people and their God.

evidence.note: Yahweh changes Abram's name to Abraham and explains it.

note: BDB key a.ae.aw covers both אַבְרָם (Abram) and אַבְרָהָם (Abraham); TIPNR records the person under Abraham@Gen.11.26.
